findings.fix: Use TerminalReason.OTHER instead of the non-existent RETRIES_EXHAUSTED when writing the test. The 3-arg TelegramSendException(null, "reason", attempts) constructor defaults to OTHER — follow the pattern at FunnelStepExecutorTest line 472.
